original_observed_behavior: Public schema required fields without explicit kind-specific type constraints.
remaining_limitation: Draft 2020-12 validation is represented structurally and by focused source inspection; external jsonschema runtime is not required by this task.
repair_approach: Added explicit Draft 2020-12-safe spec properties, reusable defs, allOf record binding, and focused schema tests.

original_observed_behavior: Public schema omitted required false-boundary fields and did not include source_repository_mutated everywhere.
remaining_limitation: Positive projection facts remain separate status fields.
repair_approach: Made model, schema, CLI boundary output, and generated statuses require every false-boundary field as const false.

original_observed_behavior: Canonical schema objects exposed unbounded additionalProperties surfaces.
remaining_limitation: General extension payload values remain opaque compatibility data, not authority.
repair_approach: Closed canonical spec objects, added explicit extensions containers, and made semantic validation refuse authority-changing extension names.

original_observed_behavior: Fixture replay used permissive missing-key removal.
remaining_limitation: No filesystem/process/network execution exists in replay.
repair_approach: Remove now requires an existing object key or valid in-range array index.

original_observed_behavior: Fixture replay shared add and replace assignment semantics.
remaining_limitation: Existing fixtures were adjusted where they had used add as replacement.
repair_approach: Replace now requires an existing target and add refuses existing object keys.

original_observed_behavior: Fixture replay accepted noncanonical or unsafe array indexes through int conversion.
repair_approach: Array indexes now require canonical non-negative decimals, with dash only for add/append.

original_observed_behavior: Unsupported-operation conformance inferred refusal from next-task naming.
remaining_limitation: Projection-time conformance uses bounded direct refusal evidence; actual CLI dispatch is proven by focused tests and validation evidence.
repair_approach: Conformance evidence now records unsupported verb probe results and Repair 03 tests exercise actual CLI dispatch for every required verb.

original_observed_behavior: No-write claims relied too much on self-declared bundle fields.
remaining_limitation: Dominium remains an already-present local checkout; freshness warning is preserved.
repair_approach: Conformance evidence records Dominium before/after state and demo records source_mutation_count 0.

remaining_limitation: Guard probes are safe refusal evidence, not executed forbidden operations.
repair_approach: Added operation guard conformance artifact and made assertions consume guard evidence for network, provider/model, worker, and mutation families.

original_observed_behavior: Operation ledger retained only an aggregate/sample view.
remaining_limitation: A sample remains only as a labeled convenience field.
repair_approach: Added complete operation-trace.json, raw trace digest, raw counts, and recomputable aggregate fields.

original_observed_behavior: Remote Git verbs were classified as ordinary git_reads.
remaining_limitation: Allowed read-only Git commands remain status, rev-parse, remote get-url, branch --show-current, rev-list, show, and ls-tree.
repair_approach: Classified fetch/pull/clone/push/ls-remote as network_attempts and branch/ref/history mutations as branch_worktree_ref_ops.

original_observed_behavior: Forbidden-operation family evidence was not separated from the main success ledger.
remaining_limitation: Main demo can still report forbidden_operation_count 0.
repair_approach: Added operation-guard-conformance.json with safe refusal probes per forbidden family.

original_observed_behavior: Portable copy used the in-memory dependency list directly.
remaining_limitation: The in-memory generator still creates the manifest before serialized copy.
repair_approach: Serialized runtime-dependency-manifest.json now drives copy with digest, path, duplicate, and hash validation.

original_observed_behavior: Portable subprocesses did not remove PYTHONPATH/PYTHONHOME or use isolated mode.
remaining_limitation: Portability subprocesses are local test processes, not AIDE workers.
repair_approach: Portable subprocesses remove unsafe Python environment variables, set PYTHONNOUSERSITE, run with -I, use unrelated cwd, compare required output sets, and verify import closure.

original_observed_behavior: fetch, pull, checkout, branch, worktree, publish, and unknown verbs fell through argparse.
repair_approach: Registered extended unsupported verbs plus destroy through one typed refusal handler preserving false-boundary output.
